apreçiaduras: apreçiadura — valuation, payment in kind at an assessed price (fem. pl.; Estas apreçiaduras mio Çid presas las ha 'my Cid has taken these payments in kind'; = apreciaduras, tasaciones)
pésevos: pesar + vos — may it grieve you (pese, present subjunctive 3rd sg., + enclitic dative vos; pésevos de mio mal 'may my hurt grieve you'; = os pese)
desondraron: desondrar — they dishonoured (preterite 3rd pl.; quem desondraron tan mal 'who dishonoured me so grievously'; = deshonraron)
riebtos: riepto — formal challenge, charge of treachery (masc. pl., spelt riebtos; a menos de riebtos 'without formal challenges'; = retos, desafíos judiciales)
merecí: merecer — I deserved (preterite 1st sg.; ¿qué vos merecí? 'what did I deserve of you?'; = merecí)
vero: vero — truth, earnest (Latin verum; en juego o en vero 'in jest or in earnest'; = veras; modern de veras)
mejoraré: mejorar — I shall make good, put right (future 1st sg.; aquí lo mejoraré 'I shall make it good here'; = mejoraré, closest repararé)
quém: que + me — who … me (relative que + me, worn down to a single consonant, cf. nol; ifantes, quem desondraron 'infantes who dishonoured me'; = que me)
descubriestes: descubrir — you uncovered, laid bare (preterite 2nd pl.; ¿A quém descubriestes las telas del coraçón? 'why did you lay bare my heart's membranes (heartstrings)?'; = descubristeis)
salida: salida — going out, departure (fem.; a la salida de Valençia 'at the departure from Valencia'; = salida)
queriedes: querer — you wished, wanted (imperfect 2nd pl., old -iedes = -íais; quando las non queriedes 'when you did not want them'; = queríais)
canes: can — dog (masc. pl., Latin canis; ya canes traidores 'O dogs of traitors'; = canes, perros)
traidores: traidor — traitor (masc. pl.; ya canes traidores 'O treacherous dogs'; = traidores)
sacávades: sacar — you took out, led away (imperfect 2nd pl., old -ávades = -abais; ¿por qué las sacávades de Valençia? 'why did you take them out of Valencia?'; = sacabais)
firiestes: ferir — you struck (preterite 2nd pl.; las firiestes a çinchas e a espolones 'you struck them with girths and spurs'; = herísteis)
espolones: espolón — spur (masc. pl.; a çinchas e a espolones 'with girths and spurs'; = espolones)
solas: solo — alone, forsaken (fem. pl.; solas las dexastes 'you left them alone'; = solas)
dexastes: dexar — you left (preterite 2nd pl.; solas las dexastes 'you left them alone'; = dejasteis)
recudedes: recudir — you answer, give satisfaction (present indicative 2nd pl.; si non recudedes 'if you do not answer'; cf. recudades; = respondéis)
levantava: levantar — was rising (imperfect 3rd sg., -ava = -aba; en pie se levantava 'he was rising to his feet'; = se levantaba)
vezós: vezar + se — he grew accustomed (vezó, preterite 3rd sg., + reflexive se; = vezóse; vezós mio Çid a llas cortes pregonadas 'my Cid has grown used to formally summoned courts'; = se acostumbró, closest se ha acostumbrado)
llas: llas — las, 'the' (fem. pl. article, spelt with ll by assimilation after a; a llas cortes 'to the courts'; = las)
pregonadas: pregonar — proclaimed, formally summoned (past participle fem. pl.; cortes pregonadas 'courts publicly proclaimed'; = pregonadas)
dexóla: dexar + la — he let it (dexó + la, the beard; dexóla creçer 'he let it grow'; dexar + infinitive 'let, allow'; = la dejó)
espanta: espantar — it frightens (present 3rd sg., the beard being the subject; los unos le han miedo e los otros espanta 'some fear him and others it frightens'; = espanta)
alta: alto — high, lofty (fem.; de natura tan alta 'of so high a lineage'; = alta)
devién: dever — they ought (imperfect 3rd pl., -ién = -ían; non gelas devién querer 'they ought not to want them'; = debían)
diera: dar — would have given (imperfect subjunctive, -ra form with conditional sense, 3rd sg.; ¿quien gelas diera? 'who would have given them to them?'; = daría, diera)
fizieron: fazer — they did, made (preterite 3rd pl.; derecho fizieron 'they did right'; = hicieron)
porque: por que — because, in that (causal, written as one word; derecho fizieron porque las han dexadas 'they did right because they have left them'; = porque)
preçiamos: preçiar — we value, esteem (present 1st pl.; non gelo preçiamos nada 'we value it not at all'; also reflexive más nos preçiamos 'we esteem ourselves more'; = apreciamos)
prísos: prender + se — he took hold of (priso, strong preterite 3rd sg., + reflexive se, = prísose, accented in print; prísos a la barba 'he took himself by the beard'; = se asió, se tomó)
criada: criar — brought up, reared (past participle fem.; a deliçio fo criada 'it was brought up in comfort'; = criada)
nimbla: ni + me + la — nor … from me … it (ni me la, with epenthetic b between m and l; nimbla messó fijo de moro 'nor did a Moor's son pluck it from me'; = ni me la)
cabra: Cabra — place name, the castle of Cabra taken by the Cid (en el castiello de Cabra 'in the castle of Cabra'; = Cabra)
rapaz: rapaz — lad, boy, young attendant (masc.; non í ovo rapaz 'there was no lad there'; = rapaz, muchacho)
pulgada: pulgada — a pinch, the amount held between thumb and finger (fem.; messó su pulgada 'plucked his pinch'; = pulgada, here pellizco)
messé: mesar — I plucked, tore out (hair or beard; preterite 1st sg.; la que yo messé 'the (hair) I plucked'; = mesé)
eguada: eguar — made even, grown back even (past participle fem. of eguar, = igualar; aun non es eguada 'is not yet grown even'; = igualada)
bolsa: bolsa — purse, pouch (fem.; en mi bolsa alçada 'kept up in my purse'; = bolsa)
ferrán: Ferrán — Fernando, short form of the name (Ferrán Go[n]çál[v]ez, one of the Infantes of Carrión; = Fernán, Fernando)
dexássedesvos: dexar + vos — leave off (dexássedes, imperfect subjunctive 2nd pl. used as a polite command, + enclitic reflexive vos; dexássedesvos Çid de aquesta razón 'leave off this matter, Çid'; = dejaos)
ssodes: seer — you are (present 2nd pl., = sodes, the s doubled after a vowel; de vuestros averes pagado ssodes 'you are paid in full of your goods'; = sois)
creciés: creçer — may it grow, arise (imperfect subjunctive 3rd sg., apocopated for creciesse, in a wish; non creciés varaja 'let no quarrel grow up'; = creciese)
varaja: varaja — quarrel, strife (fem.; varaja entre nos e vos 'quarrel between us and you'; = riña, contienda)
perteneçien: pertenecer — they were fitting, belonged (imperfect 3rd pl., -ién = -ían; non perteneçien fijas de ifançones 'daughters of ifançones were not fitting (for us)'; = pertenecían)
dexamos: dexar — we left (preterite 1st pl., the same form as the present; por que las dexamos 'in that we left them'; = dejamos)
fiziemos: fazer — we did (preterite 1st pl.; derecho fiziemos nos 'we did right'; = hicimos)
mío: mío — my (the unstressed possessive mio, accented in print at the head of the line; Mío Çid 'my Cid'; = mío)
cata: catar — he looks at (present 3rd sg.; Mío Çid … a Per Vermudoz cata 'my Cid looks at Pero Vermúdez'; = mira; modern catar means 'to taste, examine')
mudo: mudo — dumb, mute, unable to speak (adjective; Pero Mudo 'Pero the Mute', a nickname the Cid gives Pero Vermúdez, playing on the name Pero; = mudo)
callas: callar — you are silent (present 2nd sg.; varón que tanto callas 'man who are so silent'; = callas)
cormanas: cormano — first cousin (fem. pl.; primas cormanas 'first cousins'; = primas hermanas)
orejadas: orejada — a blow on the ear, box on the ear (fem. pl.; a tí dan las orejadas 'it is you they box on the ears'; = orejadas, bofetadas)
respondiero: responder — I shall have answered, I answer (future subjunctive 1st sg., spelled respondier[o]; si yo respondiero 'if I answer'; the ending -o is Pidal's form (uncertain); = respondiere)
entrarás: entrar — you will enter (future 2nd sg.; tú non entrarás en armas 'you shall not enter into arms'; = entrarás)
detiénesle: detener + se + le — is held back, sticks (detiénese, present 3rd sg. reflexive/impersonal, + dative le of the person affected; detiénesle la lengua 'his tongue is held back (sticks) on him'; = se le detiene)
delibrar: delibrar — to free oneself, get the words out, speak freely (infinitive; non puede delibrar 'he cannot speak out freely'; = librar, closest desembarazarse) (uncertain)
enpieça: empeçar — he begins (present 3rd sg.; quando enpieça 'when he begins'; = empieza)
dirévos: dezir + vos — I shall tell you (diré, future 1st sg. contracted from dezir, + enclitic vos; dirévos, Çid 'I shall tell you, Çid'; = os diré)
costunbres: costunbre — custom, habit (fem. pl.; costunbres avedes tales 'you have such habits'; = costumbres)
llamades: llamar — you call (present 2nd pl., -ades = -áis; Pero Mudo me llamades 'you call me Pero Mudo'; = llamáis)
mancará: mancar — it will fail, be lacking (future 3rd sg.; por mí non mancará 'it shall not fail through me'; = faltará)
has: aver — you have (present 2nd sg.; perfect auxiliary, de quanto dicho has 'of all you have said'; = has)
valiestes: valer — you were worth, have grown in worth (preterite 2nd pl.; por el Campeador mucho valiestes más 'through the Campeador you are worth much more'; = valisteis)
tues: tuyo — your (possessive, fem. pl., spelt tu[e]s; las tues mañas 'your ways'; = tus)
sabré: saber — I shall know how, shall be able (future 1st sg.; yo te las sabré contar 'I shall know how to tell them to you'; = sabré, closest podré)
miémbrat: membrar + te — remember (imperative 2nd sg. + reflexive te, = miémbrate with -e lost; miémbrat quando lidiamos 'remember when we fought'; = acuérdate)
lidiamos: lidiar — we fought (preterite 1st pl., same form as the present; = lidiamos, lidiábamos)
pedist: pedir — you asked for (preterite 2nd sg., apocopated -ste; pedist las feridas primeras 'you asked for the first blows'; = pediste)
vist: veer — you saw (preterite 2nd sg., apocopated; vist un moro 'you saw a Moor'; = viste)
fústel: ir + le — you went to him (fuste, preterite 2nd sg. of ir, + le, the Moor; fústel ensayar 'you went to try him, attack him'; = fuiste a él)
fuxiste: fuir — you fled (preterite 2nd sg.; antes fuxiste 'you fled before'; = huiste)
allegasses: allegar — you might come up to (imperfect subjunctive 2nd sg. in -asses; antes que a [él] te allegasses 'before you came up to him'; = llegases)
uviás: aver — if I had (not been there) (imperfect subjunctive, apocopated; the ending -ás is the 2nd sg. type as in fincás, yet the subject is yo, Si yo non uviás 'if I had not been (there)'; = hubiese) (uncertain)
jugara: jugar — would have dealt, played (imperfect subjunctive -ra, conditional sense, 3rd sg.; el moro te jugara mal 'the Moor would have dealt with you badly'; = jugaría)
passé: passar — I went past, passed (preterite 1st sg.; passé por tí 'I went past you'; = pasé)
of: aver — I had (ove, apocopated; aver de + infinitive 'to have to'; me of de ajuntar 'I had to join (battle)'; = hube)
ofle: aver + le — I had … him (of(e) = ove, preterite 1st sg., + le, the Moor; ofle de arrancar 'I had to rout him'; = hube de arrancarle)
did: dar — I gave (di with a final d; did el cavallo 'I gave the horse'; the d perhaps stands for di + te 'I gave you', cf. fústel, tóveldo, or is paragogic (uncertain); = di)
tóveldo: tener + le + lo — I kept it for you (tóvele, strong preterite 1st sg., + lo, with metathesis tóvelo > tóveldo; tóveldo en poridad 'I kept it for you in secret'; = te lo guardé) (uncertain)
descubrí: descubrir — I revealed (preterite 1st sg.; non lo descubrí a nadi 'I revealed it to no one'; = descubrí)
ovístete: aver + te — you had, you took it on yourself (oviste, preterite 2nd sg., + reflexive te; ovístete de alabar 'you came to boast'; aver de + infinitive; = te hubiste de alabar)
alabar: alabar — to praise; reflexive 'to boast' (infinitive; ovístete de alabar 'you boasted'; = alabar, here jactarse)
mataras: matar — you had killed (imperfect subjunctive -ra form, 2nd sg., in indirect speech; que mataras el moro 'that you had killed the Moor'; = habías matado, hubieras matado)
fizieras: fazer — you had done (imperfect subjunctive -ra form, 2nd sg., in indirect speech; que fizieras barnax 'that you had done deeds of valour'; = hubieras hecho)
barnax: barnax — deed of prowess, valour (barnage, spelt barnax; fizieras barnax 'you had shown prowess'; = barnaje, hazaña)
croviérontelo: creer + te + lo — they believed it (crovieron, strong preterite 3rd pl., + te, ethic dative 'of you', + lo; croviérontelo todos 'all believed it of you'; = te lo creyeron)
varragán: varragán — valiant man (barragán; mal varragán 'a poor valiant man'; the house rendering, kept distinct from varraganas 'concubines'; = barragán)
osas: osar — you dare (present 2nd sg.; ¿commo osas fablar? 'how dare you speak?'; = osas)

__broaden__.mientes: mientes — mind, attention (fem. pl., Latin mentes; parar mientes 'to pay heed, consider'; están parando mientes al … 'they are watching the …'; = mientes, closest atención) · also mentir — you lie (present 2nd sg.; Mientes, Ferrando 'you lie, Fernando'; = mientes)
